abstract: Between May 1990, and June 1994, 79 patients with malignant tumors were treated radiosurgically using a Leksell gamma unit at Asan Medical Center. Of these patients, 57 were metastatic brain tumor, 12 were glioblastoma multiforme (GM), 4 were primitive neuroectodermal tumor, 3 were malignant germ cell tumor, 2 were recurrent lymphoma, and 1 was adenoid cystic carcinoma of the orbit. Among 57 patients with metastatic tumors, 28 patients harboring 60 tumors were followed clinically and radiographically. The median marginal dose for these tumors was 30 Gy and the median survival rate was 15 months. Twenty-one tumors disappeared and 32 tumors decreased in size during 2 to 6 months after radiosurgery on computed tomographic or magnetic resonance imaging scans. All 12 patients with GM were treated with conventional radiation (6,240 approximately 6,500 cGy) after surgical resection or biopsy prior to radiosurgery (13 approximately 15 Gy to margin). The results were varied. Radiosurgical treatment of two recurrent lymphomas and three recurrent mixed germ cell tumors after radiation and chemotherapy provided rapid clinical improvement with disappearance of the tumor. However, new lesions appeared in two lymphomas and one mixed germ cell tumor within 3 to 4 months. One patient with adenoid cystic carcinoma of the orbit, who was treated radiosurgically prior to resection, is alive without recurrence 31 months after the treatment. Gamma knife radiosurgery appears to be the best alternative method to surgical excision plus radiation therapy for single and multiple cerebral metastases. It also provides rapid palliation of symptoms due to recurrent malignant tumors. And it may have an adjuvant role in the treatment of some tumors delaying local recurrence, if given prior to resection. However, the preliminary results for the malignant gliomas were inconclusive.
abstract_ja: 1990年5月から1994年6月の間に、アサン医療センターでレクセル式ガンマユニットを用い、悪性腫瘍の79例に定位放射線手術を施行した。このうち57例は転移性脳腫瘍、12例は膠芽腫(GM)、4例は原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍、3例は悪性胚細胞腫瘍、2例は再発リンパ腫、1例は眼窩の腺様嚢胞癌であった。転移性腫瘍の57例のうち、60病変を有する28例を臨床的・画像的に追跡した。病変の辺縁線量の中央値は30 Gyで、生存期間中央値は15か月であった。定位放射線手術後2〜6か月の間に、CTまたは磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で21病変が消失し、32病変が縮小した。GMの12例は、定位放射線手術の前に外科的切除または生検を行ったうえで、従来型の放射線療法(6,240〜6,500 cGy)を施行された(辺縁13〜15 Gy)。結果はさまざまであった。放射線療法と化学療法の後に再発した2例のリンパ腫と3例の再発型混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対する定位放射線手術では、急速な臨床的改善と腫瘍の消失が得られた。しかし、2例のリンパ腫と1例の混合型胚細胞腫瘍では3〜4か月以内に新病変が出現した。外科的切除に先立って定位放射線手術を施行された眼窩腺様嚢胞癌の1例は、治療後31か月再発なく生存している。ガンマナイフ定位放射線手術は、単発性および多発性の脳転移に対し、外科的切除と放射線療法の併用に代わる最良の選択肢と考えられる。また、再発性悪性腫瘍による症状の速やかな緩和をもたらす。さらに、切除前に施行すれば、一部の腫瘍で局所再発を遅らせる補助的役割を持つ可能性がある。ただし、悪性神経膠腫に対する予備的結果は結論が得られていない。
